source.name: The National - WTA Finals relocated from Riyadh to Indian Wells after two years in Saudi Arabia
source.note: Three-year hosting deal with the Saudi Tennis Federation (PIF-backed); Riyadh hosted the 2024 and 2025 Finals; the WTA requested the 2026 edition move and the STF accepted, ending the deal a year early. The 2024 Finals were the first professional women's tennis event in Saudi Arabia ($15.25m prize money).

note: Season-finale host/backer; ended after the November 2025 Finals. The 2026 Finals are at Indian Wells and Charlotte hosts from 2027 (The National, 17 Sep 2026), with the WTA working to fill the 'substantial financial gap' left by PIF.
